description: Use this to follow a creative test started with gather_test_creatives, with its id. Each call waits a while for the test before it answers. While it runs, it returns the status: call it again right away, without writing to the user in between, until it is complete or failed. When it is done: a predicted grade per creative against the others (A front-runner, B in the running, C unlikely to win), what to keep, rework or retire and why, what to test next, and simulated reactions. It starts nothing.
name: gather_creative_test_check
title: Check a creative test
